declarations.description: A web component to progressively enhance any video or iframe element to have fullscreen capabilities.
declarations.name: FullscreenControlElement

members.name: buttonText
members.description: The visible text displayed inside the fullscreen button.

members.name: buttonLabel
members.description: Optional aria-label text for the fullscreen button. Falls back to the visible button text when empty.

members.name: enterFullscreen
members.description: Requests fullscreen for the first nested video or iframe, not the host. Usually requires a user gesture. Failures are logged; the promise does not report success.

members.name: toggleFullscreen
members.description: Toggles fullscreen mode on or off.

events.name: fullscreen-control:enter
events.description: Fired on an observed transition into fullscreen for the media. Bubbles and is composed; detail is null.

events.name: fullscreen-control:exit
events.description: Fired on an observed transition out of fullscreen for the media. Bubbles and is composed; detail is null.

attributes.name: button-text
attributes.description: Visible button text. Each {name} token uses the target's first nonempty aria-label or title, or an empty string. Names use String.replace replacement string semantics, including special $ sequences; resolved output is inserted as text, not HTML. Missing or empty text uses the default.

attributes.name: button-label
attributes.description: Optional button aria-label with the same {name} substitution as button-text. Empty or identical resolved labels omit aria-label so visible text names the button. Include the visible wording in a distinct label.

cssProperties.name: --fullscreen-control-button-inset-block-start
cssProperties.description: Block-start (top) position of the fullscreen button.

cssProperties.name: --fullscreen-control-button-inset-inline-end
cssProperties.description: Inline-end (right in LTR) position of the fullscreen button.

modules.description: Class-only package entry; does not register a custom element.

declarations.name: defineFullscreenControl
declarations.description: Importing this module registers the default tag when a browser registry is available. The helper returns false without a usable registry and true when the requested tag is already defined. Calling it for another unregistered tag throws NotSupportedError because the constructor is already registered. For a custom tag, use the class-only import from fullscreen-control.js and register once without importing this module.
